$comment: Shared source-quality tiers. This file is the ONE place tier rules live; both
the Python engine and the Claude Code workflow read it, so a domain graded
wrong in one runtime cannot be graded right in the other.
T1 primary institutional  - standards bodies, regulators, filings, preprints
T3 practitioner           - blogs, forums, source repos. Real, but not authority
T4 aggregator             - DISCOVERY ONLY. Never cite as fact; follow to source
T5 content farm           - excluded, with the exclusion reported
T? resolver               - doi.org and friends. Provenance UNVERIFIED until
resolved: a resolver is not a publisher, and grading
it T1 makes a predatory journal outrank a filing.
farm_tells: \b(top \d+ best|ultimate guide|you won'?t believe|listicle|sponsored content|affiliate link)\b
